note: Proposed narrative projection over .claude/epic/tree.json. It regroups the same issues by where an actor meets the system (front office) and what holds that meeting up (back office). It owns no issue, no standing, and no routing; villages.json still routes dispatch. Office assignment is a proposal for Bdo.
cast_note: Tellers are named by the kernel's actor_kind and a CLASSIFICATION.md role; no new vocabulary. Owner is not a role: it is the context that sets Bdo's Binding and Projection and travels in a ticket's authority field.

human-operator.who: A person working inside the node through a Human Binding.

model-operator.who: A model working inside the node through a Model Binding; Sov when the profile is loaded, Claude in an interactive session.

agent.who: An operator selecting or requesting actions within granted authority.

worker.who: Leased hands. One job per lease. Reports; never settles its own work.

witness.who: Independent eyes. Observes through a path the builder did not control.

external-system.who: An enterprise system or remote provider reached through a declared adapter; its story is told on its behalf by the operator who integrated it.

peer-node.who: A second Soveraeign Node on the far side of a federation crossing. Horizon, not Phase I.
